_about: The ciphers the video deciphers on screen, one a week (ISO week number modulo the list; hero_video.py --featured SLUG picks one). Each is a real passage: 'runs' are [first, last] token indexes, inclusive, in docs/reveal/<slug>.json, whose groups and readings the scene draws; tokens without a group (clear text) are skipped. 'image' is the write-up's own credited snip of the same lines (docs/), shown first; 'crop' is [left, top, right, bottom] in its pixels (null for all of it) and 'pan' how much of the overflow the camera crosses. 'en' is the English of the passage, from the write-up; 'who', 'how', 'shelf', 'date' and 'credit' are drawn in the pixel font's capitals. A new entry needs an image on the write-up that shows the passage itself, not another page of the same letter.
